name: @activepieces/piece-raindrop
description: Bookmark manager to save, search, and organize content from the web

create_raindrop.name: create_raindrop
create_raindrop.description: Saves a new bookmark to your Raindrop.io account

link.description: The URL of the page to bookmark

title.description: Custom title for the bookmark. If left empty, Raindrop will extract it from the URL automatically.

excerpt.description: Short description or summary of the page

note.description: Personal note to attach to this bookmark

collection_id.description: Select the collection to use. Leave empty to use "Unsorted" (default inbox).

tags.description: List of tags to organize the bookmark (press Enter to add each tag)

important.description: Mark this bookmark as important / favourite

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new bookmark (raindrop) in Raindrop.io from a URL, optionally setting title, excerpt, note, tags, target collection, and favourite flag. Use to save a web page to a user's account. The URL is required; if no title is given Raindrop auto-extracts it from the page. Not idempotent: each call adds another bookmark, even for a URL already saved.

get_raindrop.name: get_raindrop
get_raindrop.description: Retrieves the details of a bookmark by its ID

raindrop_id.description: The numeric ID of the bookmark. You can find it in the URL when viewing the bookmark in Raindrop.io (e.g. raindrop.io/app/raindrop/123456789).

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a single Raindrop.io bookmark by its numeric ID. Use when you already have a bookmark ID and need its full details (title, link, tags, collection, etc.); to locate bookmarks by keyword or collection instead, use Find Bookmarks. Read-only and idempotent.

update_raindrop.name: update_raindrop
update_raindrop.description: Updates the details of an existing bookmark

raindrop_id.description: The numeric ID of the bookmark to update. You can find it in the URL when viewing the bookmark in Raindrop.io (e.g. raindrop.io/app/raindrop/123456789).

excerpt.description: Updated short description or summary of the page

note.description: Updated personal note attached to the bookmark

collection_id.description: Select the collection to use. Leave empty to use "Unsorted" (default inbox).

tags.description: New list of tags (replaces existing tags). Leave empty to keep existing tags unchanged.

important.description: Mark or unmark this bookmark as important / favourite

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Raindrop.io bookmark identified by its numeric ID, changing any of title, excerpt, note, tags, collection, or favourite flag. Only supplied fields are changed; supplying tags replaces the existing tag list. Idempotent: repeating the same update yields the same final state.

delete_raindrop.name: delete_raindrop
delete_raindrop.description: Moves a bookmark to the trash. To permanently delete it, empty the trash in Raindrop.io.

raindrop_id.description: The numeric ID of the bookmark to delete. You can find it in the URL when viewing the bookmark in Raindrop.io (e.g. raindrop.io/app/raindrop/123456789).

aiMetadata.description: Moves a Raindrop.io bookmark, identified by its numeric ID, to the trash (a soft delete; emptying the trash in Raindrop.io is a separate manual step). Use to remove a bookmark from a user's active collections. Not idempotent: a repeat call on an already-trashed or missing ID errors rather than no-ops.

find_raindrops.name: find_raindrops
find_raindrops.description: Lists bookmarks from a collection, with optional keyword search

collection_id.description: Select the collection to use. Leave empty to use "Unsorted" (default inbox).

search.description: Filter bookmarks by keyword. Supports operators like #tag or type:article. Leave empty to list all bookmarks.

limit.description: Maximum number of bookmarks to return (max 50)

aiMetadata.description: Lists bookmarks from a Raindrop.io collection, sorted newest-first. Operates in two modes: with an empty search it returns all bookmarks in the collection, and with a search query it filters by keyword (supporting operators like #tag or type:article). Defaults to a collection covering all bookmarks when none is chosen; returns up to 50 per call. Use to discover bookmark IDs or browse saved content. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
